state_contract.acceptance_path: candidate -> passing verification + passing review -> integration intent -> observed candidate revision -> accepted
state_contract.active_duplicate_attempt: rejected by unique index for task+input

state_contract.verification_receipt: requires test_hash, input_hashes, test_scope, expected_outcomes, and exit_code before a verification can be recorded

cases: accepted cannot be seeded or reached by generic transition
dependency gate enforced at ready promotion and dispatch
generic control transition cannot skip the state machine
dispatch_prepared task state and event recorded atomically with attempt preparation
forced mid-transaction dispatch failure rolls back attempt/task/event atomically
